Addon section label; not an API or standalone behavioral contract.

Collections consolidation names four UI domains but provides no callable contract or input/output expectations. Existing mount/toy/heirloom models do not prove historical addon consolidation; no new wrapper invented.

Combat-log death-watch lifecycle needs event history, timestamps and native combat ingestion. SimState.death_recaps currently stores recap IDs and killing blows, not an event history; loading/opening the UI is not proof of automatic recording.

DeathRecap_HasEvents is a Blizzard alias to C_DeathRecap.HasRecapEvents. Target is generated compatibility, not a state-backed event-presence query. Killing blows are not an event history; unknown-ID/empty semantics are unspecified on this page.

DeathRecap_GetEvents aliases C_DeathRecap.GetRecapEvents, whose generated compatibility target has no backing recap-event records. KillingBlowInfo lacks event timestamps and full event structure; inventing these from spell/amount would misrepresent the contract.

GetDeathRecapLink aliases C_DeathRecap.GetRecapLink. No state-backed legacy link builder or pinned link-format/display/error contract exists. Adjacent GetMostRecentDeathRecap does not prove link behavior.

Twitter integration and screenshot browsing require external service/authentication and capture storage/lifecycle contracts not described here; screenshot rendering alone is not SocialUI parity. No networking or placeholder service added.
Historical TGA/PNG crash is a client defect report, not a desired simulator crash. No WoW install on this host; no crash introduced or image-loader parity credited.

SendChatMessage remains a log-only outbound API using opt_string conversion. Page does not distinguish client error, silent drop or server rejection of invalid UTF-8. Native rejection/error/side-effect behavior is unproved; no guessed rejection policy added.

Explicit unexpanded Patch 6.1.0/API changes/diff transclusion. Not an empty/stub page and not expanded API coverage. Separate linked source requires its own pinned audit; no APIs or retirement names inferred from it.
